exposure: intravenous lipid emulsion administered (o-6 linoleic acid, o-9 oleic acid)
outcome: fatty acid composition of whole blood samples
cohort: The study included 1174 infants born at less than 29 weeks of gestation.
finding: Preterm infants sampled later after birth showed lower DHA and AA status, which was inversely related to sampling age and positively related to fatty acids from administered intravenous lipid emulsions.
